name: Invima
body: Share cards with an image, a sitemap with valid URLs, a permanent https redirect, and every internal link opened answered. But no page analyzed sends HSTS, so a browser's first visit can still be steered to plain http.
lesson: Send HSTS, max-age=31536000, on every https response, then consider preload.
summary: www.invima.gov.co scores 76 out of 100 (C). 3 checks fail now, 24 are at risk, and 15 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 41 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /web/login?redirect=%2Four%2Fcollections%3F, /transparencia, /el-instituto/quienes-somos and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Some pages are closed to AI answer crawlers
fix.evidence: OAI-SearchBot cannot read 1 page, ChatGPT-User cannot read 1 page, Claude-SearchBot cannot read 1 page, Claude-User cannot read 1 page.
fix.fix: Check that the closed paths are meant to stay out of AI answers.

fix.title: 19 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /web/login?redirect=%2Four%2Fcollections%3F, /transparencia, /el-instituto/quienes-somos, /el-instituto/que-hacemos and 15 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: 12 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: 3 cookies are sent without Secure
fix.evidence: Without Secure: frontend_lang, session_id, cookiesession1. Set on /, /web/login?redirect=%2Four%2Fcollections%3F, /transparencia and 17 more.
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
The start page arrived in 689 ms
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
